snippet.title: Version 1.3 Spring's Bliss | Official Trailer | Where Winds Meet
snippet.description:
The old tale lingers. A new chapter awaits. 
Spring whispers in the air. 
With Tusu wine warmed and lanterns aglow, the jianghu shall soon greet its new adventure. 

Version 1.3 "Spring's Bliss" Coming Feb 6 UTC!
